items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: That's right. Rudy Jackson was in the band. And I took Buster Bailey's place.

ctx.x: Oh. Well, I think I have it straight now. What happened? You went with that one band. Yeah, yeah. Rudy Jackson and Louie.
That's right. Rudy Jackson was in the band. And I took Buster Bailey's place. Buster was playing with Joe before.
